item.pixeldungeon.pedra_intuicao.duas_ve: You can use stones of intuition twice before one breaks: every other use consumes a stone.
item.pixeldungeon.pedra_intuicao.palpite: Guess what the type of the unidentified item is. If you guess correctly, the type will be identified!
item.pixeldungeon.pedra_choque.descricao: This runestone unleashes a blast of electrical energy which briefly stuns all nearby targets, and grants the thrower wand charge for each target hit.
item.pixeldungeon.pedra_alteracao.escolh: Augmenting for one property will reduce the other. What property would you like to enhance?

Augmenting for one property will reduce the other. What property would you like to enhance?

This item is already augmented, you can swap the augment or remove it.
dica.pixeldungeon.alteracao.velocidade: It is augmented to enhance speed.
dica.pixeldungeon.alteracao.dano: It is augmented to enhance damage.
dica.pixeldungeon.alteracao.evasao: It is augmented to enhance evasion.
dica.pixeldungeon.alteracao.defesa: It is augmented to enhance defense.
dica.pixeldungeon.pedra_usar: Right click: use on an item.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pedra_sem_item: You have no item this stone would work on.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pedra_encantamento: Your weapon glows in the darkness!
Your armor glows in the darkness!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pedra_deteccao_mag: You don't detect any magic affecting this item.
You detect both positive and malevolent magic affecting this item!
You detect positive magic affecting this item!
You detect malevolent magic affecting this item!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pedra_intuicao.cer: Correct. The item's type has been identified!
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.desconhe: This round flask contains a grainy colorful liquid. It seems to be foreign to this land, who knows what it might do when drunk or thrown?
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.maestria:
Rather than granting raw strength, this potion will instead attune the muscles of the user to a particular item. This will make that item easier to use, as if the drinker had practised with it and built muscle memory.

The chosen weapon or armor will require 2 less strength to use. This potion can only be used once on each item.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.blindage: Rather than heal, this potion will instead project a durable shield around the user's body, blocking a considerable amount of damage.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.visao_ma: After drinking this, your senses will be briefly heightened to incredible levels, allowing you to see through walls in a 12 tile radius!
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.congelam: The chemical contained in this potion will rapidly react with the air, instantly freezing and rooting all within its effect.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.bafo_de_: This flask contains an unusual compound which bursts into flame shortly after mixing with saliva. Quickly spitting the liquid will allow the user to spew flame from their mouth!
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.gas_corr: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of corrosive rust-colored gas. The gas spreads more quickly than toxic gas and is more deadly, but also won't last as long.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.vigor.de: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with a long-lasting boost of energy, allowing you to run at a quickened pace for an extended period of time.
When exposed to air, the liquid in this flask will produce a thick smoky fog which quickly spreads and blocks the vision of your enemies.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.nuvens_t: Throwing this potion will create a quickly-spreading cloud of concentrated vapor, which will condense and pour down onto the environment. Most terrain will be converted to water, fiery enemies will take damage, fire will be doused, and traps will be overwhelmed and break.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.armadura: Rather than paralyze, this liquid has a hardening effect on the skin which will turn it into temporary natural armor.
This powerful reagent will render the drinker immune to all harmful status effects for a few turns when quaffed. It can be thrown at a target to cleanse them as well.
item.pixeldungeon.pocao_exotica.inspirac:
The power of holy energy reduced to liquid form, this draught will imbue the drinker with divine power, granting them two bonus talent points in a tier of their choosing.

This potion can only be used once for each talent tier.
Select a talent tier to gain two bonus points in. You must have unlocked the tier to be able to spend the points.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pocao_inspiracao_d: You can't gain any more bonus talent points.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pocao_maestria.arm: Your weapon becomes easier to wield!
Your armor becomes easier to wear!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pocao_maestria.sem: You have no weapon or armor to master.
efeito.pixeldungeon.visao_magica: Your senses heighten: you can see through walls!
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.des: A glowing indecipherable magical rune is written on this black parchment. It seems to be foreign to this land, who knows what it will do when read aloud?
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.enc: This scroll will infuse a weapon or armor with powerful magical energy. The reader even has some degree of control over which magic is imbued.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.adi: This scroll will randomly identify four types of item that you don't currently know. The types identified can be a potion's color, a scroll's rune, or a ring's gem. The items identified won't necessarily be ones you're carrying.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.ant: The incantation on this scroll will surround you with a magical aura that temporarily blocks all magical effects, harmful or helpful. This includes most magical item effects such as wands, scrolls, rings, artifacts, enchantments, and curses. Heroic armor abilities are strong enough to work regardless however.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.ima:
The incantation on this scroll will create a colorful illusory twin of the reader. This prismatic image acts as a weaker clone of the reader, with similar defence but lower hp and damage.

The prismatic image will show itself when enemies are present, and will attempt to defend the reader.

If a prismatic image already exists, using this scroll will fully heal it.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.ene: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will, when released, charge a user's equipped artifacts over time.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.pas: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to the nearest region first floor above them. Very handy for quickly getting to a shop.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.can:
Reading this scroll emits an alluring melody which will enthrall a targeted enemy, permanently turning them into an ally! Other enemies who hear it will be temporarily charmed.

Particularly strong enemies can resist the enthrall effect, and will be charmed instead.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.vid: After reading this scroll, the detail of nearby terrain will be constantly fed to the reader's mind in crystal clarity. This effect lasts for a considerable amount of time, and will reveal all hidden doors or traps, making searching unnecessary.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.des:
When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws enemies to the user while simultaneously creating a small arena around them.

As long as the reader stays in this arena they will take 33% less damage from all sources (this is applied before other forms of damage reduction), and they will not lose satiety.

The size of the arena will scale with the size of the area the reader is in. It will be particularly small in some boss areas.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.exp:
This scroll contains incredible destructive energy that can be channeled to destroy the minds of all visible creatures.

There is significant feedback however, and the reader will also be damaged, blinded, and weakened. The more targets the scroll hits, the less self-damage will be taken.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.pav:
When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will instill incredible terror in all enemies in your field of view. So great is this effect that they will rapidly try to flee from the entire dungeon, never to be seen again!

Just like with terror, this effect can expire with time, or if the enemy is attacked.

Strong-willed enemies, such as bosses, will be inflicted with regular terror instead.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.met:
This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic, which will apply to the caster instead of to an item. The magic of this scroll will let you select one talent, and replace it with one of five talents of the same tier from different hero classes!

This effect can only apply to class talents, not talents gained from subclasses or armor abilities. Talents that you cannot use will not be given as options.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.enc: Select an enchantment to apply to your weapon.
Select a glyph to apply to your armor.
item.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_exotico.met: Choose a new talent to replace your metamorphosed talent with.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_adivinh: There is nothing left to identify!
Your scroll of divination has identified the following items:
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_canto_d: The scroll activates without a target.
Aim at an enemy to read this scroll.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pergaminho_explosa: The scroll's energy erupts into a psionic blast!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.sem_teletransporte: The magic does not work here.
efeito.pixeldungeon.antimagia: An aura makes you immune to magic!
efeito.pixeldungeon.videncia: Details of the nearby terrain fill your mind!
item.pixeldungeon.carne_grelhada.descric: It looks like a decent steak.
item.pixeldungeon.ensopado.descricao: Stewing the meat has cleansed it of any disease or parasites. It should be safe to eat.
item.pixeldungeon.pastel.descricao: An authentic Cornish pasty with a traditional filling of beef and potato. Delicious!
item.pixeldungeon.torta_de_carne.descric: A delicious pie filled with savoury meat. This will satiate you far more than any other meal.
item.pixeldungeon.pedacos_de_fruta.descr:
The blandfruit has exploded on impact, leaving inert chunks behind.

Despite a bit of dirt, these large chunks of cooked blandfruit seem perfectly edible.
item.pixeldungeon.fruta_sem_graca.descri: So dry and insubstantial, perhaps stewing it with another ingredient would improve it.
item.pixeldungeon.fruta_sem_graca.crua: You can't bear to eat it raw.
item.pixeldungeon.fruta_sem_graca.cozida: The fruit has plumped up from its time soaking in the pot and has even absorbed the properties of the seed it was cooked with. It will have the effect of whatever potion the seed corresponded to.
item.pixeldungeon.fruta_sem_graca.comer: It looks ready to be eaten!
item.pixeldungeon.fruta_sem_graca.arreme: It seems pretty volatile, it might be best to throw it.
guia.pixeldungeon.alquimia.pocoes.texto:
Welcome to Practical Applications of Alchemy! This book is a reference of recipes to craft items at an alchemy pot.

We'll start with the most iconic recipe: Potions!

Use three seeds to brew a random potion! Every seed has a potion counterpart, use multiple of the same seed to increase the chance that the potion relates to the seeds you used.
guia.pixeldungeon.alquimia.pedras.texto: Mixing a scroll into an alchemy pot will imbue its magic into two rocks within the pot. This creates runestones and identifies the scroll!
guia.pixeldungeon.alquimia.energia_e_com:
Many recipes require crystal alchemical energy, which is made by deconstructing consumable items in an alchemy pot. Energizing potions or scrolls also identifies them.

Some recipes that require energy are magical, but these ones resemble traditional cooking.
guia.pixeldungeon.alquimia.pocoes_exotic: Potions can be mixed with energy to create exotic potions. They have more powerful effects, but are often useful in different ways.
guia.pixeldungeon.alquimia.pergaminhos_e: Exotic scrolls can be made with some energy and a scroll. They're a bit stronger and more expensive than exotic potions.
item.pixeldungeon.pagina_do_guia.descric:
A torn page from a guidebook on alchemy.

Right-click to read it: it goes into your alchemy guide, which opens with the "Guide" button of the alchemy pot.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pagina_do_guia.leu: You found the "%s" page of the alchemy guide!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.pagina_do_guia.com: You already have every page of this guide.
tela.pixeldungeon.guia_de_alquimia.nenhu: You haven't found any page of the alchemy guide yet. They are kept in the dungeon's laboratories.
item.pixeldungeon.kit_do_alquimista.desc:
This toolkit contains a number of reagents and herbs along with a small mixing vial, allowing for alchemy on-the-go. The vial contains what looks like alchemical energy crystals in liquid form.

The equipped toolkit is slowly generating alchemical energy as you gain experience. It looks like the mixture in the vial could be enhanced by adding energy crystals to it.
Your toolkit has not finished warming up.
You need at least 6 energy for that.
tela.pixeldungeon.kit_do_alquimista.ener:
Every 6 energy crystals will give the toolkit enough energy to gain a level, which increases the rate that the toolkit generates energy over time, and how quickly it warms up.

How much energy would you like to use?
dica.pixeldungeon.kit_do_alquimista.uso: Right click: brew (opens alchemy without a pot; spends the toolkit energy first). Sneaking: energize (every 6 energy is one level).
Your toolkit is already at its maximum level.
The mixture in the vial grows stronger!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.antimagia.pergamin: You can't read a scroll while magic immune.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.antimagia.varinha: Your wand fizzles; you cannot use wands while magic immune.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.antimagia.item: You can't use magical items while immune to magic.
item.pixeldungeon.bomba.descricao:
A fairly hefty black powder bomb. An explosion from this bomb deals 4-12 damage (plus 1-3 per depth) to anything adjacent to it, and will destroy some adjacent terrain or items.

It looks like the fuse will take a couple rounds to burn down once it is lit.
item.pixeldungeon.bomba_de_gelo.descrica: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing 4-12 damage (plus 1-3 per depth) and spreading a sustained gust of freezing air within 2 tiles.
item.pixeldungeon.bomba_de_la.descricao: This customized bomb will create a wide field of magical sheep after exploding. The explosion will deal 4-12 damage (plus 1-3 per depth) to anything within 2 tiles. The sheep will block movement and persist for a very long time! The sheep will not last as long in the presence of powerful enemies though, and can be manually dispelled sooner by interacting with them.
item.pixeldungeon.bomba_de_fogo.descrica: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing 4-12 damage (plus 1-3 per depth) and spreading sustained flame within 2 tiles.
item.pixeldungeon.bomba_de_barulho.descr: This customized bomb will repeatedly make noise when its fuse runs out. When something touches the bomb, it will explode and deal 4-12 damage (plus 1-3 per depth) to anything within 2 tiles!
item.pixeldungeon.bomba_de_fumaca.descri: This bomb has been modified to spew a thick cloud of gas at the same time as exploding. It will deal 4-12 damage (plus 1-3 per depth) and spread shrouding fog within 2 tiles.
item.pixeldungeon.bomba_de_clarao.descri: This customized bomb will erupt into a blast of light, sound, and electricity when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take 4-12 damage (plus 1-3 per depth) from the explosion, an additional 25%% damage from the electricity, and be stunned for 10 turns.
item.pixeldungeon.bomba_de_brotamento.de: This customized bomb will splash life-giving liquid everywhere within 3 tiles instead of exploding. The area caught in the blast will rapidly sprout grass and plants. Yourself and any allies caught in the blast will be healed as if they had drank a potion of healing.
item.pixeldungeon.bomba_sagrada.descrica: This bomb has been modified to flash holy light in a larger area when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take 4-12 damage (plus 1-3 per depth) from the explosion, and undead or demonic enemies will take an additional 50%% damage from the holy light.
item.pixeldungeon.bomba_arcana.descricao: This bomb has been imbued with arcane properties. It will explode into a powerful blast similar to Goo's pumped up attack, dealing 4-12 magical damage (plus 1-3 per depth) to anything within 2 tiles.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.bomba.apagou: You quickly snuff the bomb's fuse.
dica.pixeldungeon.bomba: Right click: light and throw (explodes 2 turns later; right click it to snuff the fuse). Sneaking: throw without lighting.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.bomba.disparada: The noisemaker is already triggered: it can't be picked up!
item.pixeldungeon.metal_liquido.descrica:
This magical liquid can fill into the cracks and tears on a thrown weapon, restoring it to perfect condition! If a set of weapons is missing a weapon but otherwise fully repaired, then liquid metal can even be used to replace a missing weapon from the set!

A tier 1 weapon requires 10 liquid metal to be fully repaired, a tier 5 weapon requires 30. Each upgrade also increases the amount of metal needed by 35%.

Liquid metal cannot be used to repair the tips on tipped darts.
item.pixeldungeon.resina_arcana.descrica:
This fine powder shimmers between shades of purple and white. It can act as an amplifier to magical energies, increasing the level of wands when it is applied to them!

Upgrading a wand costs 1, 2, or 3 resin depending on the wand's initial level. Resin can upgrade wands to a maximum of +3.

Resin upgrades are overridden by other upgrade sources however (such as scrolls of upgrade), and do not apply when imbuing a wand into the Mage's staff.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.metal_liquido.inte: That thrown weapon is already in perfect condition!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.metal_liquido.usou: You use %s liquid metal to repair your thrown weapon.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.resina_arcana.nive: That wand is too powerful for resin to improve.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.resina_arcana.usou: You coat your wand with resin, increasing its power!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.resina_arcana.pouc: You don't have enough resin for that! (you need %s)
mensagem.pixeldungeon.metal_liquido.nada: You don't have any thrown weapon.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.resina_arcana.nada: You don't have any identified wand.
item.pixeldungeon.infusao_caustica.descr: This brew will spread corrosive ooze in a wide area around the location it shatters in. Anything caught by the ooze will slowly melt if it can't wash it off in water.
item.pixeldungeon.infusao_nevasca.descri: When shattered, this brew will unleash a swirling blizzard which quickly spreads like a gas.
item.pixeldungeon.infusao_infernal.descr: When shattered, this brew will unleash a raging inferno which quickly spreads like a gas.
item.pixeldungeon.infusao_choque.descric: When shattered, this brew will unleash an electrical storm in a wide area around the location it breaks at.
item.pixeldungeon.infusao_aquatica.descr: When shattered, this brew will release a burst of pressurized water at its location. It's only forceful enough to damage fiery enemies, but it also spreads water to nearby terrain, disables traps, douses fires, and knocks back characters near the burst.
item.pixeldungeon.infusao_instavel.descr:
This magical brew glows with shifting colors of the rainbow.

When drank or thrown it will trigger the effect of a random potion. The potion effect will always be beneficial if it is drank, and will always be harmful if it is thrown.
item.pixeldungeon.elixir_sangue_de_draga: When consumed, this elixir will send fiery power coursing through the drinker's veins. This effect will make the drinker immune to fire, and allow them to set enemies aflame with physical attacks.
item.pixeldungeon.elixir_toque_gelido.de: When consumed, this elixir will allow the drinker to sap the heat from enemies they attack. This effect will make the drinker immune to the cold, and allow them to chill enemies with physical attacks.
item.pixeldungeon.elixir_essencia_toxica: When consumed, this elixir will imbue the drinker with toxic energy. The drinker will continuously spread toxic gas as they move, and will be immune to toxic gas and poison for slightly longer than the duration of the effect.
item.pixeldungeon.elixir_poder.descricao: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point and temporarily increasing maximum health by 4 + HP/20 points. The health boost scales with your maximum health, but will slowly wear off as you gain levels.
item.pixeldungeon.elixir_queda_suave.des: This elixir offers a weaker but more controlled levitation effect, allowing the drinker to fall great distances without harm for a little while.
item.pixeldungeon.elixir_armadura_arcana: This elixir will grant the drinker a long lasting resistance to magical damage.
item.pixeldungeon.elixir_rejuvenesciment: This elixir contains the remains of Goo enhanced with a healing potion. While it will not provide immediate healing, it will steadily restore a greater amount of health while you are standing in water.
efeito.pixeldungeon.elixir_poder: Newfound strength surges through your body, you now have %s strength!
efeito.pixeldungeon.queda_suave: You feel light as a feather!
dica.pixeldungeon.infusao: Right click: throw (it shatters where it lands).
item.pixeldungeon.feitico_instavel.descr:
This small black square crystal has shifting runic symbols on each of its surfaces.

When activated, it will trigger the effect of a random scroll. The scroll effect will always be combat focused if there are enemies in your field of view, and will always be non-combat focused otherwise.
item.pixeldungeon.feitico_alquimizar.des: This spell contains transmutative powers similar to those found in an alchemy pot. Each cast allows the user to turn an item (or stack of items) into alchemical energy. Turning potions or scrolls into energy will even identify them!
item.pixeldungeon.feitico_infusao_magica:
This spell possesses the same magical power as a scroll of upgrade, but in a more stable form.

In addition to upgrading an item as normal it will never erase an enchantment, glyph, or curse.
item.pixeldungeon.feitico_mudanca_de_fas:
This chaotic spell will teleport any character it is aimed at to a random location on the current floor, and stun them for a significant amount of time. Powerful foes will be able to resist the stunning effect.

With no target in your aim, the spell is not used up.
item.pixeldungeon.feitico_reciclar.descr: This spell contains a lesser form of transmutation magic. While it won't work on equipment, this spell will transform a scroll, potion, seed, or runestone into a random item of the same type.
item.pixeldungeon.feitico_farol_de_retor: This intricate spell grants the user the ability to return to a set location, regardless of distance. The spell will only be consumed by returning, it can be set as many times as you like, but it will only remember the most recent location it was set to.
item.pixeldungeon.feitico_agarrao_teleci:
This spell allows the caster to remotely grab all items at a location, or all thrown weapons stuck to an enemy!

It can't be used to grab items that someone else owns, or to grab containers like chests.

With nothing in your aim, the spell is not used up.
tela.pixeldungeon.farol_de_retorno:
This beacon was set somewhere on floor %s.

Setting will override the location the beacon was previously set to.

Returning will return to your last set location and consume one use of the spell.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.feitico.infundiu: Your item is infused with arcane energy!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.feitico.farol_sela: The strong magic aura of this place prevents you from using the spell!
mensagem.pixeldungeon.feitico.farol_marc: The beacon was set here, on floor %s.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.feitico.sem_alvo: There is nothing in your aim.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.feitico.sem_item: You have no item this can be used on.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_cranio_de_ra: This macabre trinket isn't much larger than the skull of a normal rat, which is somehow a rarity down in this dungeon. The skull's magical influence seems to attract the more rare denizens of the dungeon, making them appear far more often.
At its current level this trinket will make rare exotic enemies %sx as likely to appear.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_pedaco_de_pa: This little scrap of parchment looks like it came from a scroll. It has retained some of its magic, and it seems to be influencing weapons and armor found in the dungeon.

At its current level this trinket will make enchantments and glyphs %sx as common, and curses on weapons and armor %sx as common. Curses on wands, rings, or artifacts are not affected.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_semente_petr: This seed has been fossilised, either by slow geological processes or by magic. The seed seems to be magically influencing the flora of the dungeon, occasionally replacing plant seeds with runestones.
At its current level this trinket will cause trampled grass to drop runestones instead of seeds %1$s%% of the time, and will also cause high grass to drop items %2$s%% more often.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_cristais_exo: These small pink crystals have the same shape as crystals of alchemical energy. While they can't be used for energy directly, they seem to be somehow influencing the potions and scrolls you find.

At its current level this trinket will replace %s%% of potion or scroll drops with their exotic equivalents. This does not affect potions of strength, scrolls of upgrade, or items that are generated to help solve hazard rooms.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_moita_de_mus: This clump of wet moss seems to hold onto its moisture no matter how hard you squeeze it. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making grass and water more likely to appear.

At its current level this trinket will make %s%% of unthemed floors become filled with either water or grass instead.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_relogio_de_s: This small handheld sundial is somehow able to cast a shadow in the depths of the dungeon, even if you aren't holding it upright. Even more strangely, the shadow's position seems to have no relation to the sun in this world. When no shadow is cast, the sundial seems to attract danger.

At its current level, this trinket will reduce the spawning rate of enemies by %1$s%% during the daytime in real life (8am-8pm), and increase the spawning rate of enemies by %2$s%% at nighttime (8pm-8am).
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_trevo_de_tre: Somehow stewing in the alchemy pot has caused this clover to grow a bunch of extra leaves! It's not really clear if this trinket is lucky or unlucky, perhaps this trinket will make your luck more chaotic?
At its current level this trinket will cause you to deal maximum damage %1$s%% of the time, and minimum damage %2$s%% of the time.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_mecanismo_de: The core mechanism of one of the dungeon's pitfall traps, carefully carved out of the floor so it can be carried. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making hazardous terrain more common but also increasing your affinity towards it.
At its current level this trinket will make %1$s%% of unthemed floors become filled with traps instead. Additionally, %2$s%% of the dungeon's hidden traps will instead be visible.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_dente_de_mim: This large sharp tooth must have been pulled from a very unhappy mimic. It seems to be influencing the mimics of the dungeon, making them more frequent and dangerous.
At its current level this trinket will make mimics %1$sx more common.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_resina_marav: This shimmering blue resin appears to have the distilled essence of a cursed wand's magic. The magic from the alchemy pot has seemed to stabilize it somewhat, and it's now affecting your wands.

At its current level this trinket will force cursed wand effects to become neutral or positive %1$s%% of the time, and will cause uncursed wands to fire an additional neutral or positive cursed zap %2$s%% of the time.

This trinket costs a larger amount of energy to upgrade.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_olho_de_sala: This golden and black newt's eye is a common ingredient, now enhanced into a trinket. The eye seems to be reducing your vision in exchange for letting you see things in other ways.
At its current level this trinket will reduce your vision range by %1$s%%, but will also grant you mind vision on enemies within %2$s tiles.
This large salt crystal was cut into an almost perfect cube shape, and it somehow managed to drain half the water from the alchemy pot instead of dissolving. It seems to be magically dehydrating and preserving the food you eat, extending the satiety you get, but also lessening your health restoration when not starving.
At its current level this trinket will increase the amount of time before you grow hungry by %1$s%%, but will also reduce your rate of health regeneration by %2$s%%.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_frasco_de_sa: This thin vial contains the blood of some denizen of the dungeon, it moves slowly as you rotate the vial. It seems to be magically enhancing stronger healing effects, but also delaying them.

At its current level this trinket will increase the overall health you gain from drinking potions of healing by %1$s%%. However, this healing will also occur more slowly, regenerating a maximum of %2$s of your max HP per turn.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_fragmento_do: After stewing in the alchemy pot, this small shard of cursed metal has changed to be made of... nothing? Light seems to bend around it, and it hovers in place when you aren't holding it. The shard seems to be magically drawing power from your ignorance, so it's probably best to not think about it too much.

At its current level this trinket will increase the rate that enemies drop loot by 20%% for each piece of unidentified equipment you have equipped or recently used, to a max of %s item(s). The shard will also prevent you from identifying equipment, but can be used to manually identify items that are ready for it.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_incensario_c: After some time in the alchemy pot this incense-burning censer appears to be producing smoke all on its own! These gasses build up and will spew forth from the censer toward enemies at semi-random intervals. It seems capable of producing all sorts of gasses, but you'll get a moment of warning just before the censer activates.

At its current level, this trinket will spawn a harmful gas near an enemy roughly every %s turns. Gasses will only appear when enemies are present. At higher levels these gases are more likely to be exotic and powerful.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_tufo_de_fura: A tuft of silky white ferret fur, held together by a Lime green ribbon tied into a bow. Ferrets are known for their agility, mischievousness, and lack of integrity. Some of that power seems to radiate from the trinket, enhancing the evasion of anything nearby.
At its current level this trinket will increase the evasion of all characters by %1$s%%.
item.pixeldungeon.acessorio_luneta_trinc: This handheld telescope would be a demonstration of great and precise workmanship, if it weren't for the crack along its front lens. The spyglass seems to be helping you by revealing new items in the dungeon, but due to its flaw the revealed items are quite hard to see!
At its current level, this trinket has a %1$s%% chance to create an extra item on each non-boss floor.
At its current level, this trinket has a 100%% chance to create an extra item on each non-boss floor, and a %1$s%% chance to create a second extra item.
item.pixeldungeon.catalisador_magico.des:
This ball of magical golden dust glimmers in the darkness of the dungeon. This catalyst can be used at an alchemy pot with a little alchemical energy to produce a unique trinket item.

Trinkets provide various different effects that slightly alter the dungeon or its inhabitants. Trinkets can be upgraded with more energy to make their effect more powerful, or dropped to forego the effect entirely.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.fragmento.pronto: An item is ready to identify: %s. Use your Shard of Oblivion on it to identify it.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.incensario: Your censer is about to spew: %s.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.fragmento.nada: No equipment is ready to be identified.
dica.pixeldungeon.acessorio: Upgrade at an alchemy pot: %s energy.
dica.pixeldungeon.fragmento: Right click: identify a piece of equipment that is ready.
guia.pixeldungeon.alquimia.bombas.texto: A standard black powder bomb can be mixed with a specific item to create an enhanced bomb.
guia.pixeldungeon.alquimia.armas.texto:
Some of the lighter or more magical weapons can be used in alchemy!

Each thrown weapon set produces enough liquid metal to fully repair another set of the same level and tier. Note that alchemizing a set will destroy the whole set, even if it isn't all present!

One wand will produce enough arcane resin to upgrade two wands of the same level, but no higher than +3.
guia.pixeldungeon.alquimia.compostos_e_e: Brews and elixirs are advanced potions with a variety of effects, usually with a single use.
guia.pixeldungeon.alquimia.feiticos.text: Spells are contained in crystals and provide a variety of effects, usually with multiple uses.
item.pixeldungeon.chave_de_cristal.descr: The cut surfaces of this crystalline key shimmer in the darkness. Perhaps it will open something made of crystal?
item.pixeldungeon.pote_de_mel.descricao: This large honeypot is only really lined with honey, instead it houses a giant bee! These sorts of massive bees usually stay in their hives, perhaps the pot is some sort of specialized trapper's cage? The bee seems pretty content inside the pot with its honey, and buzzes at you warily when you look at it.
dica.pixeldungeon.pote_de_mel: Right-click: throw it (it shatters where it lands). Sneaking: shatter it here.
item.pixeldungeon.pote_quebrado.descrica:
The pot has been shattered, only the sticky honey that lines its walls is holding it together, and it is slowly coming apart.

Despite its broken state, the bee still seems to want to protect the pot.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.porta_de_cristal: This locked door is made of magical crystal. You can see through, but you'll need a crystal key to open it.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.porta_de_cristal_a: The crystal key opened the door.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.barricada: The wooden barricade is firmly set but has dried over the years. Might it burn?
mensagem.pixeldungeon.bau_de_cristal: You can see %s inside, but to open the chest you need a crystal key.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.bau_de_cristal_abe: The crystal key opened the chest.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.poco.saude: As you take a sip, you feel your wounds heal completely.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.poco.consciencia: As you take a sip, you feel knowledge pour into your mind.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.sacrificio.digno: The fire consumes your offering and grows stronger.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.sacrificio.indigno: The fire consumes your offering, but doesn't change.
mensagem.pixeldungeon.sacrificio.premio: The fire flares and then dissipates, leaving a reward behind!
tema.pixeldungeon.abismos: Your steps echo across the dungeon.
tema.pixeldungeon.agua: You hear water splashing around you.
tema.pixeldungeon.grama: The smell of vegetation is thick in the air.
tema.pixeldungeon.escuro: You can hear enemies moving in the darkness.
tema.pixeldungeon.grande: This dungeon floor seems unusually large.
tema.pixeldungeon.armadilhas: The ground seems especially treacherous here.
tema.pixeldungeon.segredos: The atmosphere hints that this floor hides many secrets.
armadilha.pixeldungeon.fogo.descricao: Stepping on this trap will ignite a chemical mixture, setting the surrounding area aflame.
armadilha.pixeldungeon.explosiva.descric: This trap contains some powdered explosive and a trigger mechanism. Activating it will cause an explosion in the immediate area.
